function refreshModuleEWidgets() {
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
  if (window.Plotly) {
    $('.js-plotly-plot').each(function () {
      try { Plotly.Plots.resize(this); } catch (e) {}
    });
  }
  if (window.HTMLWidgets) {
    $('.leaflet.html-widget').each(function () {
      try {
        var w = HTMLWidgets.find('#' + this.id);
        if (w && w.getMap) { w.getMap().invalidateSize(); }
      } catch (e) {}
    });
  }
}
$(document).ready(function () {
  setTimeout(refreshModuleEWidgets, 350);
});

### Task 14: Top 8 Flag x Gear Drivers (Hotspot A vs Hotspot B) {data-width=600}

```{r chart3-fg-subplot}
build_box_bars <- function(box_name) {
  sub_all <- fg_all[fg_all$box == box_name, ]
  top8 <- sub_all[sub_all$plot_category != "Other combinations", ]
  other_row <- sub_all[sub_all$plot_category == "Other combinations", ]
  other_hrs <- sum(other_row$hours)
  other_shr <- sum(other_row$share)

  df <- rbind(
    top8[, c("combo", "gear_display", "hours", "share")],
    data.frame(
      combo = "Other combinations",
      gear_display = "Other combinations",
      hours = other_hrs,
      share = other_shr,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
  df <- df[order(df$share), ]
  named <- df[df$combo != "Other combinations", ]
  df <- rbind(df[df$combo == "Other combinations", ], named)
  df$combo <- factor(df$combo, levels = df$combo)
  df$share_pct <- df$share * 100
  df
}

dfA <- build_box_bars("A: NW Pacific coastal shelf")
dfB <- build_box_bars("B: NW Atlantic")
max_x <- max(c(dfA$share_pct, dfB$share_pct)) * 1.16

make_facet <- function(df, shown_gears, facet_title) {
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (g in unique(df$gear_display)) {
    sub <- df[df$gear_display == g, ]
    show_leg <- !(g %in% shown_gears)
    p <- add_bars(
      p, data = sub,
      x = ~share_pct, y = ~combo,
      name = g,
      legendgroup = g,
      showlegend = show_leg,
      marker = list(color = unname(GEAR_PALETTE[g])),
      hovertemplate = paste(
        "<b>%{y}</b><br>",
        "Share: %{x:.2f}%<br>",
        "Hours: %{customdata:,.0f}<extra></extra>"
      ),
      customdata = ~hours
    )
  }
  p %>% layout(
    barmode = "stack",
    xaxis = list(range = c(0, max_x), ticksuffix = "%", rangemode = "tozero"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = levels(df$combo)),
    annotations = list(
      list(
        text = facet_title,
        x = 0.01, y = 1.03,
        xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
        xanchor = "left", yanchor = "bottom",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(size = 12, color = "#172F40")
      )
    )
  )
}

pA <- make_facet(dfA, character(0), "<b>Hotspot A: NW Pacific (30.74M hrs, 351 combos)</b>")
shown_in_A <- unique(dfA$gear_display)
pB <- make_facet(dfB, shown_in_A, "<b>Hotspot B: NW Atlantic (0.84M hrs, 47 combos)</b>")

subplot(pA, pB, nrows = 2, shareX = TRUE, margin = 0.08) %>%
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    xaxis = list(title = "Share of Hotspot Annual Fishing Hours (%)",
                 range = c(0, max_x), ticksuffix = "%", rangemode = "tozero"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = -0.14),
    margin = list(l = 175, r = 25, t = 35, b = 75)
  ) %>%
  config(responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

### Task 15: Normalized Monthly Trajectories vs Global Benchmark {data-width=550}

```{r chart5-dygraphs}
dates_2023 <- seq(as.Date("2023-01-01"), as.Date("2023-12-01"), by = "month")
g_vec <- t15_share$share[t15_share$series == "Global benchmark"] * 100
a_vec <- t15_share$share[t15_share$series == "Hotspot A"] * 100
b_vec <- t15_share$share[t15_share$series == "Hotspot B"] * 100

ts_mat <- cbind(
  `Global benchmark`        = g_vec,
  `Hotspot A (NW Pacific)`  = a_vec,
  `Hotspot B (NW Atlantic)` = b_vec
)
ts_xts <- xts(ts_mat, order.by = dates_2023)

month_tick_fn <- "
function(a, b, pixels, opts, dygraph, vals) {
  var months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  var ticks = [];
  for (var m = 0; m < 12; m++) {
    var d = new Date(2023, m, 1).getTime();
    ticks.push({ v: d, label: months[m] });
  }
  return ticks;
}"

month_val_fn <- "
function(ms) {
  var months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  var d = new Date(ms);
  return months[d.getMonth()] + ' 2023';
}"

dygraph(ts_xts, main = "Normalized Monthly Share (Sums to 100% per Series)") %>%
  dySeries("Global benchmark", strokePattern = c(7, 3), color = COL_GLOBAL, strokeWidth = 2.2) %>%
  dySeries("Hotspot A (NW Pacific)", color = COL_A, strokeWidth = 2.4) %>%
  dySeries("Hotspot B (NW Atlantic)", color = COL_B, strokeWidth = 2.4) %>%
  dyAxis("x", ticker = htmlwidgets::JS(month_tick_fn),
         valueFormatter = htmlwidgets::JS(month_val_fn)) %>%
  dyAxis("y", label = "Share of Annual Fishing Hours (%)", valueRange = c(0, 20)) %>%
  dyOptions(rightGap = 22) %>%
  dyHighlight(highlightCircleSize = 5, highlightSeriesBackgroundAlpha = 0.35,
              hideOnMouseOut = TRUE) %>%
  dyLegend(show = "always", width = 520)
```

```{r row5-audit}
                               table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'))
)
```
